items.criterion: The health route answers with its status once the app is ready
items.judgment: the status field is present

items.criterion: Every public route renders a complete document from the server
items.judgment: the served markup carries the studio's own words

items.criterion: The sequence renders its eight marked blocks in the stored order
items.judgment: each block carries its own marker value

items.criterion: The published stack reads contiguously from one in stack order
items.judgment: the returned orders run without a gap

items.criterion: Each card's veil is derived from its position in the published stack
items.judgment: the first card is dimmest and the last is clear

items.criterion: A reorder regrades every veil in the column
items.judgment: the card now first wears the first veil

items.criterion: The archive wall is packed so that no two items overlap
items.judgment: every pair of rectangles is disjoint

items.criterion: Two reads of the archive return the same item positions
items.judgment: the two documents agree rectangle for rectangle

items.criterion: Every award count is computed from its own win records
items.judgment: recording one more win moves the count up by one

items.criterion: One submission key produces exactly one stored inquiry
items.judgment: a repeat returns the first row

items.criterion: An invalid brief is refused and writes no row
items.judgment: the stored count is unchanged

items.criterion: An automated submission is stored with its reason
items.judgment: the stored row carries its spam reason

items.criterion: An erased inquiry keeps its row and its events
items.judgment: every personal field reads the erasure marker

items.criterion: The trail chains each row to the row before it
items.judgment: every prev_hash matches the previous hash

items.criterion: Publication is refused until the client approval matches the revision
items.judgment: the stored state is unchanged after the refusal

items.criterion: An unpublished case answers a stranger as an unknown address does
items.judgment: the two responses carry one status

items.criterion: A review token reaches one case revision only
items.judgment: another unpublished case is refused to that token

items.criterion: Every uploaded cover lives in the object store under its generated key
items.judgment: the key exists in the bucket

items.criterion: A writer is refused at every lead-owned endpoint
items.judgment: the protected state is unchanged

items.criterion: Every response carries the standard security headers
items.judgment: the nosniff header is present
